items.title: Trump envoy Kushner arrives in Israel after rare Hamas talks on Gaza peace plan
items.description: US President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner is expected to meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu later on Monday.

items.title: Ukrainian strikes kill six in Russia, acting governor says
items.description: A 14-year-old child was among four others injured, the acting governor of Russia's Belgorod region says.

items.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
items.description: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

items.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
items.description: The outbreak was already the fastest growing on record, caused by a rare species of Ebola called Bundibugyo.

items.title: Record rains drench South Korean city as landslide kills one
items.description: It comes as large swathes of East and South East Asia have been pummelled by dats of heavy rain.

items.title: Four 'extraordinary' Renaissance paintings stolen from Italian museum
items.description: The works were taken overnight without alarms being triggered, raising suspicion of a professional hit.

items.title: Two dead and hundreds evacuated after twin fires break out on Greek island
items.description: About 200 firefighters worked to keep the fires from converging on Salamina, with one now under control.

items.title: Ferrari's first ever electric car sold for record $40m
items.description: The Luce's launch drew backlash from some commentators who said it broke from the brand's signature dramatic styling.

items.title: Aussie rules footy players under investigation as police probe sexual assault claim
items.description: The Sydney Swans confirmed an incident had occurred in the hours after the team's win on Sunday.

items.title: Teen suspect in Virginia campus shooting found hiding in closet
items.description: The attack left five injured outside a halls of residence, and the suspect was not a student there, say police.

items.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
items.description: Dozens more are seriously injured after the tourist bus overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.

items.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
items.description: Hundreds of homes and public buildings have been severely damaged with at least 53 people killed.
